summary__en: Steal an Egg's Halloween event is live. It adds the Halloween Dimension, an event zone with its own eggs and pets, including the Divine Voidseer Pumpkin and the Secret Grave Cerberus. The Enchanted Forest zone is in the game too. The community wiki shows the event started earlier in October; this entry is the Roblox publish our update tracker saw on 23 Oct 2026, when we added both zones to our lists. Event pets are marked limited.
source_note: Publish time from the Roblox games API (our update tracker); what the event adds is from the community wiki
